timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hello and welcome to take 50 of the Ryan Zaramat nomination video. That is indeed a
Drupalcon lapel pin in the pattern of a union jack on my shoulder because I've
heard that is the way in candidacy speeches to demonstrate your devotion to the
commas. In reality I'm nominating myself because I was invited to, based on a
track record of using and contributing to Drupal that goes more than pin deep. I've
been around for 12 years first as the creator of and project lead of UberCart,
then as the co-founder of CommerceGuys, then as the project lead of Drupal
Commerce. And now as the actual owner of CommerceGuys, since I engineered our
split and spin out from platform.sh a little over a year ago. Beyond being
invited and encouraged to nominate myself to the Drupal Association Board, I'm
doing it because my personal mission coincides almost directly with the
mission of the Drupal Association Board. My whole career has been spent
promoting Drupal, fostering the growth of Drupal, and doing so in what is
another wise crowded space, the e-commerce application space. I've made a
career out of bringing new users to Drupal through UberCart and new
contributors to Drupal and financial sponsors of Drupal through the
relationships that we built through developed these e-commerce ecosystems
within the Drupal world. And while I have contributed in capacities as a
developer, a document or a theme or supporter, speaker, sponsor and more, I have
yet to contribute as a member of the Drupal Association Board. So I humbly ask
for your consideration and just present my experience in the Drupal community
as my qualifications. Please refer to my candidacy profile on the association
website for more information and background if you're interested in. I would
say the priorities of the Drupal Association that I'm most interested in
contributing to are the maintenance of Drupal.org and DrupalCon to further the
growth of the project and also in the financial sustainability and long-term
viability of the association. Because I, again, I'm a product of and believer in
the mission of the association and really of the Drupal community at large. And I
want to see it succeed long-term and I believe that my unique perspective can
be a very welcome and helpful voice as the Drupal Association tries to do
this job. So that's all I've got. Feel free to ask any questions you have and I
will answer them as honestly and transparently as I can. And thank you for your
consideration to this seat.

youtube_description:
Hey everyone, just a short, choppy video shot on my phone explaining who I am and why I've nominated myself. I picked a goofy thumbnail on purpose (didn't give YouTube much to work with). Feel free to make fun of me in the comments. : )

Community voting takes place from March 6th - 18th. Read more in my candidate profile on the Association website here:

https://assoc.drupal.org/election/2017-director-large-election/candidate-14
